models.name: rsclip
models.train_data: BigEarthNet.txt captions x reBEN patches (80k subset)
models.notes: Domain-adaptation core. ViT-B/32 with patch-embed inflated 3->14 channels (12 S2 bands + VV/VH). Its frozen image tower is the backbone of M2, M3, M4 and M6 -- train first.

models.name: vqa
models.train_data: RSVQA-LR (57,223 active train QA pairs, disjoint image splits)
models.notes: v1 shipped. KNOWN DEFECT: comp scores BELOW its own blind ablation (-0.8pt) because mean-pooled bag-of-words discards word order, so 'more roads than forests' == 'more forests than roads'. v2 replaces the question encoder with a BiGRU and the backbone with M1.

models.name: caption
models.notes: Prefix-tuned: M1 embedding -> 10 soft prompt tokens -> small causal decoder. ~50ms on CPU vs ~4s for M7, and a working fallback if the VLM fails on demo day.

models.name: ground
models.notes: M1 patch grid + text tower -> 2-layer cross-attention -> box head. L1 + generalised IoU loss. Answers 'highlight the water body'.

models.name: change_map
models.notes: Siamese M1 -> feature differencing -> light U-Net decoder -> binary mask. Produces the spatial evidence overlay.

models.name: change_vqa
models.train_data: CDVQA (2,968 SECOND pairs, ~122k QA, 19 answer classes)
models.notes: Shares M5a's siamese trunk; mask supervision improves the VQA head and it is one model to serve instead of two.

models.name: fusion
models.train_data: BigEarthNet v2 co-registered S1+S2, BEN-19 multilabel
models.notes: S2 (12-band) + S1 (VV/VH) branches -> cross-attention -> BEN-19 multilabel. Init from BIFOLD resnet50-s2 / resnet101-s1. MUST normalise per-sensor from metadata -- ISRO evaluates on Cartosat-2S + RISAT, not Sentinel. Never hardcode Sentinel stats.

models.name: vlm
models.train_data: IndiaSat instruction mix -- 8,962 pairs over 985 patches (captioning, binary, MCQ, referring boxes)
models.notes: Frozen M1 vision tower -> 17 visual prefix tokens -> 4-layer causal decoder (d=256, 2.34M trainable of 3.52M). CPU-trainable, which the 2B Qwen3.5-VL+QLoRA plan is not on this hardware (bitsandbytes is CUDA-only) -- same architecture idea at a size that fits, so the tower swaps for the Kaggle ViT-B/32 without a redesign. Greedy decoding: an auditable trace needs the same imagery and question to give the same answer. It narrates; it never supplies a number. Every percentage in a report comes from serve/analysis.py, measured off the pixels.

vlm.architecture: frozen M1 vision tower -> 17 visual tokens -> 4-layer causal decoder (d=256, 2.34M trainable)
vlm.caveat: Word-level vocabulary of 265 tokens over one corpus. It answers IndiaSat-style instructions about Indian Sentinel patches; it is not a general-purpose VLM. Quantitative percentages in a report come from the measured spectral indices, never from this model.

dataset.name: IndiaSat
dataset.note: BigEarthNet contains zero Indian data — its labels come from CORINE, a Europe-only product. Swapping CORINE for ESA WorldCover reproduces the recipe over India.
